prompt: Governments give a lot of support to artists, even though some people think it is a waste of money that could have been used elsewhere. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
intro_note: Band-7 rewrite of the original W6 essay preserving the writer's preference for investment in digital technology. It completes the public-funding case for culturally valuable projects, compares this fairly with digital mental-health and online public services, and treats technology as a complement to artists rather than their replacement. Hover any highlight for the craft note and what it fixes.
